headline: Inside how Titans were convinced to trade their best player
summary: Titans GM Mike Borgonzi got an offer he couldn't refuse, and now Jeffery Simmons is a Chicago Bear.

headline: Jeffery Simmons, Quenton Nelson will renew their rivalry at Bears-Seahawks Monday night
summary: Nelson vs. Simmons will be the most-watched offensive lineman vs. defensive lineman battle of this NFL season, as two All-Pros go at it again on new teams.

headline: Panthers relieve Ejiro Evero of defensive coordinator duties
summary: The Carolina Panthers are moving on from defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero, the team announced Firday, with defensive line coach Todd Wash taking over on an interim basis.

headline: Christian Watson spat up blood, broke a rib, went to the hospital and returned to the game
summary: Watson left Lambeau Field in an ambulance, spent an hour getting checked at the hospital, and then rode in an ambulance back to the stadium and played again.
